comment: Single populated 25x24 stripboard ('sans LFO section') with a legend below; nine transistors, a charge-pump IC and two large glass diodes. The off-board labels print Q5 twice and no Q4, and the legend lists '1N5817' under D1 although the board's third diode is D3.
uncertain: Q4: not labelled on the drawing; one of the two transistors labelled Q5 (bottom, columns 13 and 19) must be Q4, which one is not stated. Part types per the legend are unaffected
D3 (top left, row A): legend prints 'D1: 1N5817' after 'D1-D2: D220'; taken as a typo for D3
750K at the left (column 4, rows M-P): printed clearly, unusual value
82pF at the left (column 3, rows P-Q): printed clearly, unusual value
Fuzz Sw and Wah Sw: the drawing does not say whether they are toggles or footswitches
